professionalSummary.title: Professional Summary
professionalSummary.content:
Fullstack developer student at Teknikhögskolan (2-year YH program) with a primary focus on Java backend development and React frontend. Experienced in building structured, maintainable applications with emphasis on clean architecture, RESTful APIs, and database design.

Strong foundation in databases, security principles, DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including CI/CD workflows and version control using Git with structured branching strategies. Accustomed to working in agile environments with iterative development, code reviews, and collaborative teamwork.

Driven by problem-solving, continuous learning, and writing scalable, secure, and production-oriented code.

education.title: Education
education.description: Comprehensive fullstack development program with emphasis on Java backend and modern frontend development.

coreAreas.design: System design and object-oriented analysis & design (OOAD)
coreAreas.cicd: CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git, structured workflows)

education.focus: Focus on building scalable, secure, and maintainable systems aligned with industry practices.

item1.title: Programming 1 (High School Course)
item1.description: Introduction to programming fundamentals and computational thinking.

item2.title: Java Programming in Context
item2.description: Comprehensive Java fundamentals including object-oriented programming principles, design patterns, exception handling, collections framework, and building structured, maintainable applications. Focus on writing clean, testable code and applying best practices for enterprise development.

item3.title: Databases in Context
item3.description: Relational database design principles, SQL query optimization, data modeling (ER diagrams, normalization), transaction management, indexing strategies, and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with database management systems and implementing secure, efficient data access layers.

item4.title: Backend in Context
item4.description: Advanced backend development using Spring Boot framework, building RESTful APIs with proper HTTP methods and status codes, implementing authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth), server-side architecture patterns (MVC, layered architecture), dependency injection, and integrating with databases and external services.

item5.title: Frontend in Context
item5.description: Modern frontend development with React including hooks, context API, state management, component lifecycle, routing, form handling, API integration, responsive design principles, CSS frameworks, and UI/UX best practices. Focus on building accessible, performant single-page applications.

item6.title: Object-Oriented Analysis & Design
item6.description: System architecture and design using UML diagrams (class, sequence, use case), SOLID principles, design patterns (Factory, Singleton, Observer, Strategy), domain-driven design concepts, and OOAD methodologies for building scalable, maintainable software systems. Emphasis on translating business requirements into technical solutions.

item7.title: Learning at Work 1
item7.description: Developed an online e-shop for chess products and community platform to connect the Swedish chess scene with clubs and products. Worked primarily with frontend technologies including TypeScript, HTML, CSS, deployed on Vercel. Responsibilities included bug fixes, implementing new features, and integrating Shopify e-commerce functionality for product management and checkout.

item8.title: Producing and Delivering Software
item8.description: Complete software development lifecycle from planning and production to deployment and delivery. Covered project management methodologies, CI/CD pipeline setup, containerization (Docker), cloud deployment, monitoring and logging, documentation practices, and delivering production-ready software with focus on quality assurance and maintainability.

item9.title: Learning at Work 2 / Thesis Project
item9.description: Working on a claims application to handle warranty cases for businesses using Java backend with Supabase and MongoDB databases, React frontend with HTML/CSS. Responsibilities include writing unit and integration tests, code refactoring, bug fixes, implementing new features, and integrating with ERP systems. Simultaneously developing thesis project 'Personality Miner' with one classmate, investigating optimal methods (RAG, fine-tuning, or structured prompting) for guiding local LLMs within ethical boundaries.

project1.title: Budget Tracker
project1.description: A Java Spring Boot application for tracking personal finances by managing income and expenses with structured budget categories.

project2.title: Plantswap
project2.description: A Spring Boot marketplace application enabling users to buy, sell, and trade plants with other enthusiasts in a community-driven platform.

project3.title: Homi
project3.description: A collaborative full-stack Airbnb clone built with a team of 3 developers. Features property listings, user authentication, and booking system with separate backend and frontend repositories.

project4.title: HealthcareSDLC
project4.description: A collaborative healthcare booking application developed by a team of 4, emphasizing SDLC methodology, DevOps, and DevSecOps practices with automated CI/CD pipelines and code quality monitoring.

project5.title: Finance Tracker
project5.description: A comprehensive personal finance tracking application developed as a solo project, featuring full CI/CD implementation, automated testing, and code quality checks. Manages expenses, income, budgets, and financial goals.

project6.title: Personality Miner
project6.description: Collaborative thesis project with one classmate, investigating which method – RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), fine-tuning, or structured prompting – is most effective for guiding a local Large Language Model (LLM) to stay within defined ethical boundaries during psychological self-reflection.
